p: mockers with me: Instead of comfort, being now at death's door, he had but them that mocked at him, and discouraged him.
Lay down now: He reasons with God as a man beside himself, so that his cause might be brought to light.
will strike hands with me: And answers for you?
understanding: That these my afflictions are your just judgments, though man does not know the reason.
He that speaketh flattery to his: He who flatters a man, and only judges him happy in his prosperity, will not himself only but in his posterity be punished.
byword of the people: God has made all the world speak of me, because of my afflictions.
this: That is, when they see the godly punished: but in the end they will come to understanding and know what will be the reward of the hypocrite.
way: That is, will not be discouraged, considering that the godly are punished as well as the wicked.
you all: Job speaks to the three who came to comfort him.
night into day: That is, have brought me sorrow instead of comfort.
the grave is mine house: Though I should hope to come from adversity to prosperity, as your discourse pretends.
father: I have no more hope in father, mother, sister, or any worldly thing: for the dust and worms will be to me instead of them.
They shall go down to the: All worldly hope and prosperity fail which you say, are only signs of God's favour but seeing that these things perish, I set my hope in God and in the life everlasting.
